value.text: Springfield Fall 2026 swim lessons open Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m. for Max and Mia. Residents get their date first, and the general public opens 7 days after that. The registration page is https://rec.example.org/springfield/fall-2026. Max's age fits the published band. Mia is just outside it, so please check she fits before you register. I never register for you. Here is what I'll send if you approve: a week-ahead note 7 days before, a checklist 3 days before, a reminder the evening before, and a heads-up 15 minutes before it opens. Once you pick a course, send me its link and the morning text will include it.
